column1: # Disposition of every CI-reducer abort whose remedy bullets name a `ci_method`
# (M100). Enumerated by data-raw/enumerate-ci-method-remedies.py; `--check` fails
# when a current site carries no row here, or when a row matches no site.
# disposition:
#   sweep  -- the abort is triggered by DEGENERATE DATA, so a bullet naming
#             another ci_method claims that method survives data which has
#             already defeated one. data-raw/sweep-abort-remedies.R measures it.
#   fence  -- the abort is triggered by a design, an argument, or an engine
#             capability, not by the data being degenerate. The named default is
#             not being asked to survive anything, so there is nothing to sweep.
# This milestone measures; it changes no message. Every `sweep` row below records
# what the sweep found about the method its shipped bullet names, and NOT what the
# bullet should therefore say -- that judgment, and every edit it licenses, is the
# next milestone's.
# WHAT THIS LEDGER DOES NOT COVER. It is complete over what the enumerator
# matches, and the enumerator is a line scanner with stated edges.
# PROBED LIMITS: 6 predicate shapes (L1-L6), 5 unreported splice shapes; file
# scope stated, no probe.
# That line is parsed by `enumerate-ci-method-remedies.py --self-test`, which
# compares its two counts against the script's own probe lists and fails on a
# divergence; the identical line appears in the script docstring and is parsed
# there too.
# The six PROBED predicate shapes are: a bullet in a single-quoted string, a
# named splice (`i = cause`), a quoted bullet name (`"i" = `), a method named
# without the literal `ci_method = "value"` adjacency, an abort raised by a
# wrapper outside the scanner's list, and an abort call that does not open its
# line. Each of the six is CONSTRUCTED and shown unmatched by a probe; the
# script's docstring lists them as L1-L6.
# File scope -- anything outside `R/ci-*.R` -- is a further limit, and the one
# NO probe demonstrates. It is stated here and not counted among the six.
# So "every site is classified here" means every site the predicate matches, and
# a bullet written in one of those shapes is not gated by this file. The splice
# reporter narrows the second of the six to one shape -- a whole line that is a
# bare identifier -- and is not a gate on spliced variables in general; the five
# shapes it stays blind to are probed the same way.
